DehydratedData.title: Dehydrated runtime data
DehydratedData.description: Encoded data used to reconstruct runtime structures, including pointer relocations and zero runs.
DehydratedData.investigation: Compare physical binary sections with logical hydration-target accounting. This summary node is not an ordinary graph contributor; an exact bucket-label search may not identify its constituents. Disabling dehydration is not a saving recommendation.

ResourceData.title: Embedded resource payloads
ResourceData.description: A concatenation of embedded resources from compilation input assemblies.
ResourceData.investigation: Inspect the resource inventory by assembly and container. Decoded child assets and input DLL containers may overlap or differ from published resource payloads.

Metadata.title: Native reflection metadata
Metadata.description: Encoded NativeAOT metadata for retained types, methods, fields, signatures and constants.
Metadata.investigation: Open metadata kinds, types and strings. The metadata log supplies record starts and a lower bound, not exclusive source ownership.

TypeGenericDictionary.title: Generic dictionary
TypeGenericDictionary.description: Runtime lookup slots for a concrete generic type or method, used by shared canonical code.
TypeGenericDictionary.investigation: Inspect generic families and their concrete producer arguments. Dictionary layout and slot demand also matter; identity counts alone do not measure either.

MethodGenericDictionary.title: Generic dictionary
MethodGenericDictionary.description: Runtime lookup slots for a concrete generic type or method, used by shared canonical code.
MethodGenericDictionary.investigation: Inspect generic families and their concrete producer arguments. Dictionary layout and slot demand also matter; identity counts alone do not measure either.

ArrayOfFrozenObjects.title: Preinitialized frozen objects
ArrayOfFrozenObjects.description: A compiler-produced segment containing preinitialized managed object data.
ArrayOfFrozenObjects.investigation: Inspect the non-additive FrozenObjects projection for concrete objects. It overlaps Blobs and can be a hydration target; do not add it to this bucket.

ReflectionInvokeMap.title: Reflection-to-method map
ReflectionInvokeMap.description: Mappings from reflection metadata to generated method bodies.
ReflectionInvokeMap.investigation: Investigate reflectable methods and reflection-invoke edges. Broad reflection requirements are a possible size driver, not a proven cause for this build.

ExternalReferencesTable.title: Runtime symbol references
ExternalReferencesTable.description: Indexed references to compiler symbols used by runtime tables.
ExternalReferencesTable.investigation: Inspect consuming metadata and reflection/generic tables. A reference count is neither bytes nor unique ownership.

GenericMethodsHashtable.title: Compiled generic-method lookup
GenericMethodsHashtable.description: A runtime hashtable describing compiled generic method instantiations.
GenericMethodsHashtable.investigation: Inspect generic method families and their arguments. This summary records compiled entries; it does not itself prove why each entry was retained.
